title: Takarṭa Yettbeddilen — Qarṭaǧ d Lebḥer Alemmas
desc: Timura n Qarṭaǧ seg 814 ar 146 uq.Ɛ., amennuɣ n Hannibal, iberdan n Hannon d Himilcon, imddukal d yimɛaddayen: takarṭa yettbeddilen yerna tezmer ad tettwaseqdec.
links.0.title: Hannibal Barca
links.0.text: Seg Carthagène ar Zama, tudert n uqayed i yessergigin Ṛuma.
links.1.title: Imenɣan Ipunikiyen
links.1.text: Tlata imenɣan, yiwen leqwarn n umennuɣ ɣef Lebḥer Alemmas.
links.2.title: Hannon
links.2.text: Abrid-is deg trawin n Tafriqt n Lɣarb.
sources.0.author: Polybe
sources.0.note: imenɣan ipunikiyen ; amtawa gar Hannibal d Philippe V
sources.1.author: Tite-Live
sources.1.note: abrid n Hannibal, amennuɣ apunik wis sin
sources.2.author: Appien d'Alexandrie
sources.2.note: amennuɣ apunik wis tlata d uɣelluy n Qarṭaǧ
sources.3.author: Anonyme
sources.3.note: abrid n Hannon rrif n trawin n Tefriqt (ur fhimen ara akk ɣef ubrid-is)
sources.4.author: Pline l'Ancien
sources.5.note: isefka n tkarṭa n wadeg azayez ; tilisa n zik d tamuɣli kan, akken i d-tban deg tezrawin n umezruy.
